title: TraiNDSim: A Simulation Framework for Comprehensive Performance Evaluation of Neuromorphic Devices for On-Chip Training
problem: Existing simulation frameworks fail to accurately reflect neuromorphic device characteristics during on-chip training, making it difficult to reliably evaluate and compare neuromorphic device performance for neural network training.
motivation: Accurate simulation frameworks are essential for developing and validating neuromorphic devices as efficient alternatives for deep neural network training.
method: TraiNDSim employs layer-wise normalization to constrain weight ranges based on initial weight distribution, refines three conductance models with improved non-linearity handling, implements bi-directional weight representation, and applies conductance compensation techniques to comprehensively simulate neuromorphic device training behavior.
key_novelty: Advanced layer-wise normalization strategy that accounts for initial weight distribution to accurately model conductance behavior in neuromorphic devices during on-chip training.
contributions: Layer-wise normalization strategy for weight range management in neuromorphic device training
Refined conductance models with improved non-linearity representation for accurate device simulation
Bi-directional weight representation with conductance compensation technique
TraiNDSim simulation framework for comprehensive neuromorphic device on-chip training evaluation

metrics.accuracy: Simulation fidelity in reflecting neuromorphic device training behavior and impact of device parameters

primary_theme: simulation framework for neuromorphic device training
